question: Rourkela steel plant was established in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1959**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Rourkela Steel Plant** was established in the year **1959**, marking a significant milestone in India's industrial development.
 
• It was the first public sector steel plant in India to be set up with the technical collaboration of a foreign country, specifically **Germany**.
 
• Located in **Rourkela**, Odisha, the plant was developed under the second Five-Year Plan to boost the country's steel production capacity.
 
• The plant is operated by the **Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL)**, one of the largest state-owned steel-making companies in India.
 
• Rourkela Steel Plant played a vital role in driving India's industrial growth by producing high-quality steel for various sectors such as construction, railways, and heavy engineering.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Five-Year Plans and Rourkela Steel Plant:**

 
 
• The establishment of the Rourkela Steel Plant was part of India's **Second Five-Year Plan (1956-61)**, which focused on industrialization and self-reliance.
 
• The plant was envisioned to support India's growing demand for steel and reduce dependence on imports.
 
 
 
• **Technical Collaboration:**
 
 
• The plant was set up with the technical assistance of the German firms **Krupp** and **Demag**, showcasing India's willingness to adopt advanced technology from abroad.
 
• This collaboration helped in building a strong foundation for India's steel industry.
 
 
 
• **Features of Rourkela Steel Plant:**
 
 
• The plant has advanced facilities for **hot and cold rolling**, as well as a wide range of steel-making processes.
 
• It is equipped to produce a variety of steel products such as **plates, sheets, and structurals**, catering to diverse industrial needs.
 
 
 
• **Importance to Odisha:**
 
 
• The establishment of the Rourkela Steel Plant contributed significantly to the **economic development** of Odisha, creating numerous job opportunities and boosting the state's infrastructure.
 
• It also led to the growth of ancillary industries in the region.
 
 
 
• **Other Major Steel Plants in India:**
 
 
• **Bhilai Steel Plant** in Chhattisgarh, established in 1959 with Soviet collaboration.
 
• **Durgapur Steel Plant** in West Bengal, established in 1959 with British collaboration.
 
• **Bokaro Steel Plant** in Jharkhand, established in 1972 with Soviet collaboration.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL):**

 
 
• SAIL is a **Maharatna company** and one of the largest steel producers in India.
 
• It operates major steel plants across India, including Rourkela, Bhilai, Durgapur, Bokaro, and Burnpur.
 
 
 
• **Role in Nation Building:**
 
 
• Rourkela Steel Plant has contributed significantly to India's infrastructure development, including the production of steel for **railways, bridges, and dams**.
 
• It has also supported India's defense sector by supplying specialized steel for **armored vehicles and missile systems**.
 
 
 
• **Economic Impact:**
 
 
• The plant has not only generated employment but also facilitated the growth of small and medium-scale industries in the region.
 
• It has enhanced India's export potential by producing high-quality steel products for the global market.
